Composition API: getCurrentInstance.description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { getCurrentInstance } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
Only callable synchronously during `setup()`. `proxy` is the component instance — the same object as `this` in the Options API, so `proxy.$refs`, `proxy.$router` etc. are reachable from `setup()`.
An escape hatch: prefer props, `emit` and composables where possible.
